summary: Parkevtate Vosianc's September 23 video is a buy-and-earnings-timing guide ahead of Micron's September 30 investor update (after market close), addressing investors torn about the stock being up ~264% year-to-date. His central argument: the surge is justified by fundamentals, not hype. The June-quarter results were 'absolutely incredible' — revenue of $41.4B (up from $9.3B, more than 4x year-over-year) and operating profit of $33.3B with an 80% operating margin, the first above-80% quarterly operating margin he has seen in a decade of analysis. Demand is unprecedented: products sold out for 2026 and most of 2027, with 2028 sellout conversations beginning; management guides $50B revenue and ~86% gross margin next quarter. Analysts forecast FY2027 (ending August) revenue of $247B (+90%) and $281B in 2028, so he sees no revenue cliff until at least FY2029. Cash flow from operations jumped ~4x to $45.7B in the nine months ended May 28, and the September 15 demo of a 512GB DDR5 RDIMM server memory module with AMD and Intel testing shows continued innovation. He argues Micron is still priced as cyclical (forward P/E of just 6 vs an S&P average of ~4x that), with longer-term customer agreements reducing — but not removing — cyclicality. His updated DCF fair value is $1,439/share vs a $1,041 market price, implying 38%+ upside over 12-18 months. Timing advice: new investors allocate 75% before / 25% after earnings; existing holders reverse it (25%/75%). Also mentions Super Micro Computer. Calls per supplied list: MU BUY @ $1,041 stated.
title: Revealed! Everything You Need to Know About Micron's Sept. 30 Investor Update

calls.thesis: Undervalued into Sep 30 earnings: unprecedented demand, sold out for 2026 and most of 2027, 80%+ operating margins, forward PE ~6.
calls.bull_case: If market stops pricing it as purely cyclical, multiple re-rates toward 40-50x like non-cyclical growers.
calls.bear_case: Still cyclical at heart; a demand slowdown (not expected before FY2029) would collapse EPS.
